Northeast College of Health Sciences is committed to academic excellence, leadership and professional best practices. 

Northeast offers a broad range of graduate-level natural and integrative healthcare programs: Doctor of Chiropractic, Master’s in Diagnostic Imaging,  Master’s in Clinical Anatomy, Master’s in Applied Clinical Nutrition (online), Master’s in Human Anatomy and Physiology Instruction (online), Master's in Physician Assistant Studies, AAS in Radiologic Technology, AAS in Diagnostic Medical Sonography and Certificate in Massage Therapy.

Student-customized curriculum ensures graduates are fully prepared for building strong professional careers within the integrated, collaborative model that is the future of healthcare delivery.
